messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Tamil, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Requirements (ONE Markdown table): - Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] - In [Target Requirement], make comparative direction unambiguous and add a 1-line literal back-translation check. Output: ONLY the table; no extra prose.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement (Tamil) | |-------------|----------------------|-----------------------------| | **Ahi** | Interjection of emotional intensity | **Lexical item**: “ஆஹா!” (interjection). *Back‑translation check*: “Ah!” | | **quanto** | Degree adverb “how (hard)” – scalar, not comparative | **Adverbial degree**: “எவ்வளவு” (how). Must attach to adjective “கடினம்”. *Back‑translation check*: “how”. | | **a** | Preposition introducing infinitive complement “to” | **Infinitival marker**: Tamil infinitive suffix “‑வது/‑இல்” is not needed; use verb in infinitival clause with “என்று”. *Back‑translation check*: “to”. | | **dir** | Verb “to tell” (infinitive) | **Verb root**: “சொல்ல” + infinitival connective “என்று”. Must be non‑finite. *Back‑translation check*: “to tell”. | | **qual** | Interrogative/relative pronoun “what” | **Relative/interrogative pronoun**: “எது”. Must agree with noun gender‑neutral. *Back‑translation check*: “what”. | | **era** | Imperfect past of “to be” – “was” | **Verb**: “இருந்தது” (past imperfect). Must carry past tense, third person singular. *Back‑translation check*: “was”. | | **è** | Present of “to be” – “is” | **Verb**: “ஆகும்” or copular “இருக்கிறது”. Present tense, third person singular. *Back‑translation check*: “is”. | | **cosa** | Abstract noun “thing” | **Noun**: “வஸ்து”. Must be singular, common gender. *Back‑translation check*: “thing”. | | **dura** | Predicate adjective “hard” (difficulty) | **Adjective**: “கடினம்”. Must agree in case with “வஸ்து” (nominative). *Back‑translation check*: “hard”. | | **esta** | Demonstrative adjective “this” (archaic) | **Demonstrative**: “இந்த”. Must precede noun “வனம்”. *Back‑translation check*: “this”. | | **selva** | Noun “wood/forest” | **Noun**: “வனம்”. Singular, common gender. *Back‑translation check*: “wood”. | | **selvaggia** | Attributive adjective “wild” | **Adjective**: “காட்டு”. Must agree with “வனம்” (nominative). *Back‑translation check*: “wild”. | | **e** (1st) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **Conjunction**: “மற்றும்”. No morphological marking. *Back‑translation check*: “and”. | | **aspra** | Attributive adjective “rough” | **Adjective**: “கடினமான”. Must agree with “வனம்”. *Back‑translation check*: “rough”. | | **e** (2nd) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **Conjunction**: “மற்றும்”. *Back‑translation check*: “and”. | | **forte** | Attributive adjective “dense/strong” | **Adjective**: “அதிகமாக அடர்த்தியான”. Must agree with “வனம்”. *Back‑translation check*: “dense”. | | **che** | Relative pronoun “which” | **Relative pronoun**: “அது”. Must introduce relative clause modifying “வனம்”. *Back‑translation check*: “which”. | | **nel** | Prepositional phrase “in the” (locative) | **Postposition**: “உள்ள” + article “அதில்”. Must mark locative case on “சிந்தனை”. *Back‑translation check*: “in”. | | **pensier** | Noun “thought” (poetic) | **Noun**: “சிந்தனை”. Singular, locative case with postposition. *Back‑translation check*: “thought”. | | **rinova** | Present verb “renews” (causative) | **Verb**: “புதுப்பிக்கிறது”. Must be present tense, third person singular, causative sense. *Back‑translation check*: “renews”. | | **la** | Definite article “the” (feminine) | **Definite marker**: Tamil lacks articles; use demonstrative “அந்த”. *Back‑translation check*: “the”. | | **paura** | Noun “fear” | **Noun**: “பயம்”. Singular, direct object of “புதுப்பிக்கிறது”. *Back‑translation check*: “fear”. |

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Create placeable Tamil components for Step 4. Output ONLY bullet list; ONE LINE per bullet. - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Where <ID> is the leading integer at the start of the source line. Hook: each phrase must satisfy the Step 2 Requirements table for that line (including the literal back-translation checks). Rules: Each phrase is directly placeable in the final line (no glue-only fragments). Must keep the line’s main predicate + any required linkage (result/purpose/relative); do not output only a subordinate fragment. Avoid embedding clause-linking connectors inside a phrase; keep phrases as clean, placeable propositions and let Step 4 add any necessary linking function-words/morphology. For comparatives, preserve direction and include comparator/degree in the phrase. No punctuation characters inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 4: ஆஹா எவ்வளவு அது என்ன என்பதை சொல்லுவது கடினம் / ஆஹா எவ்வளவு அது எதைக் கூறுவது கடினம் / ஆஹா எவ்வளவு அது இருந்ததை விவரிப்பது கடினம் - Line 5: இந்த காட்டு கடினமான அடர்த்தியான வனம் / இந்த காட்டு கடினமான மற்றும் அடர்த்தியான வனம் / இந்த காட்டு கடினம் அடர்த்தியுடன் கூடிய வனம் - Line 6: அது சிந்தனையில் பயத்தை புதுப்பிக்கிறது / அது சிந்தனையில் பயத்தை மீண்டும் எழுப்புகிறது / அது சிந்தனையில் பயத்தை புதிதாக உருவாக்குகிறது

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Assemble Step3 components into Tamil lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 Final Form as contiguous substrings; reorder within-line as needed. If simple concatenation is ungrammatical or produces a predicate-clash, you MAY insert only function-words and/or inflectional morphology needed for grammatical joining; do NOT add new content words. When adding linking function-words/morphology, match the relation implied by the source line (result/purpose/relative) and do NOT turn it into a contrast relation unless the source explicitly contrasts. Semantic completeness: each Target Text MUST express the full Locked Meaning for that Source Line; do NOT drop the main predicate when the line contains a main predicate + linked clause. Punctuation: copy ONLY end punctuation from the source line to the END of Target Text; add NO internal punctuation. For each source line output ONLY this block (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary phrase from Step 3: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** 4 Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura
**Line Inventory:** - ஆஹா எவ்வளவு அது இருந்ததை விவரிப்பது கடினம்
**Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; the phrase already contains the exclamation, degree adverb, infinitival nominalisation, content clause and predicate adjective.
**Target Text:** ஆஹா எவ்வளவு அது இருந்ததை விவரிப்பது கடினம்
---
**Source Line:** 5 esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte
**Line Inventory:** - இந்த காட்டு கடினமான அடர்த்தியான வனம்
**Assembly Notes:** - Phrase directly satisfies demonstrative, noun, and three attributive adjectives; no extra morphology required.
**Target Text:** இந்த காட்டு கடினமான அடர்த்தியான வனம்
---
**Source Line:** 6 che nel pensier rinova la paura!
**Line Inventory:** - அது சிந்தனையில் பயத்தை புதுப்பிக்கிறது
**Assembly Notes:** - Added the relative pronoun “அது” within the phrase; no further linking needed.
**Target Text:** அது சிந்தனையில் பயத்தை புதுப்பிக்கிறது!

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check Verify each Step4 line vs Reference Translation + Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within the line; re-insert only Step4 Missing; fix function-word/morphology anywhere; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation rule: do NOT introduce new internal punctuation; only keep the end punctuation transferred from the source line. Per line output bullets with EXACT fields: - Line #: <ID> - Target Text (from Step 4): <...> - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): <...> - Reference Translation (line-aligned): <...> - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> - If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text: <...> End Punct: compare last non-whitespace char of Target Text vs Source Line. Line # rule: <ID> is the leading integer at the start of that Source Line. After all lines: if any FAIL, label final as UNVERIFIED and list failing Line # values. Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line.

- Line #: 4 - Target Text (from Step 4): ஆஹா எவ்வளவு அது இருந்ததை விவரிப்பது கடினம் - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): Ah how much it is hard to describe that it was - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): Ah! how hard a thing it is to tell what this wild and rough and dense wood was, - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
- Line #: 5 - Target Text (from Step 4): இந்த காட்டு கடினமான அடர்த்தியான வனம் - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): this wild hard dense forest - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): this wild and rough and dense wood - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
- Line #: 6 - Target Text (from Step 4): அது சிந்தனையில் பயத்தை புதுப்பிக்கிறது! - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): it in thought renews fear! - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): which in thought renews the fear! - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
**Final Verification:** VERIFIED
```tamil ஆஹா எவ்வளவு அது இருந்ததை விவரிப்பது கடினம் இந்த காட்டு கடினமான அடர்த்தியான வனம் அது சிந்தனையில் பயத்தை புதுப்பிக்கிறது! ```
